objective: Systematically inventory and review the full publicly available Kalshi documentation surface to discover economically relevant mechanisms, exceptions, interactions, ambiguities and future WATCH triggers that candidate-driven research may miss.
completion_rule: Do not mark complete until the enumerated public documentation universe is reconciled against the coverage manifest and unresolved gaps are explicitly zero; inaccessible or dynamic surfaces must be recorded as gaps.
required_surfaces: WebSocket documentation, sequencing and lifecycle semantics
public regulatory filings/certifications that define or change venue mechanics

four_angle_review.angle_1_semantic_rules: Prove exact rule meaning, state space, settlement, exceptions, source hierarchy and cross-document conflicts.
four_angle_review.angle_2_technical_implementation: Inspect REST/WebSocket/schema/UI/order-lifecycle/timing behavior and identify documented implementation interactions or mismatches.
four_angle_review.angle_3_economic_execution: Ask whether any legal executable path can have net EV > 0 after fees, depth, fills, queue, collateral, slippage, latency, partial fills and settlement risk. Cents per episode remain valid if reproducible.
four_angle_review.angle_4_adversarial_change_watch: Search for hidden failure modes, prior negative evidence, rule/regime dependencies and concrete future triggers that should reopen a WATCH item.

acceptance_criteria: Coverage manifest exists and inventories the discovered Kalshi public documentation universe with URL/path, observed version/timestamp and provenance/hash where practical.
Every manifest item has a review status; gaps are explicit rather than silently omitted.
Every material finding has all four angle fields completed or an explicit reason an angle cannot yet be evaluated.
Every possible positive-EV mechanism is preserved even if expected absolute profit is only cents; scale/capacity affect ranking, not admission.
Existing candidate and negative-evidence records are checked before presenting a finding as new.
Every regime-dependent negative or currently unattractive mechanism gets concrete WATCH/recheck triggers when later rule, fee, source, access, liquidity or API changes could matter.
Recon does not claim PROVEN_EDGE; serious candidates are routed to specialists and Red Team/Pentest for independent falsification.
No live trading, wallet movement, paid action, credential abuse, unauthorized access or active security exploitation.
proof_standard: Existing AGENTS.md triple self-check, point-in-time, negative-evidence and execution-first rules remain mandatory in addition to this four-angle Recon pass.
